name: P27 music — the Sound Room jukebox: real recorded instruments (lazy per zone), hand-written counterpoint, crossfades, stingers, ducking

steps.msg: every theme, variant and cue is registered
all CANON §9 music ids exist
melody sits on the harmony on strong beats (tension/lullaby chromatics and the wedding's ringing bells are intentional)

steps.note: counterpoint: every accompaniment line in the three core themes is hand-written, and no line just doubles the tune

steps.eval: (async () => { const { counterpoint } = await import('/src/audio/score/index.js'); window.__cp = counterpoint(['village','overworld','battle','title','town']); return window.__cp; })()

steps.msg: no generator-made pads/arpeggios/bass in village, overworld, battle, title or town
each core theme has at least four independent hand-written lines besides the tune
no non-tune line doubles the melody (same onset, same pitch class) more than half the time (it used to be 91-100%)
no loop theme has notes written past its loop end (that made the engine skip the loop's opening beats)
the bass lines move by step, not in root-fifth jumps

steps.note: a held note must not warble: one velocity layer per note, and the loops themselves are level-flattened

steps.eval: (async () => { const b = await __DQ.renderAudio('note:clarinet:G4:mp:12:60', 14); const d = b.getChannelData(0), sr = b.sampleRate, h = Math.floor(sr * 0.1); const db = []; for (let i = Math.floor(sr * 1.5); i + h < Math.floor(sr * 11); i += h) { let s = 0; for (let j = 0; j < h; j++) s += d[i + j] * d[i + j]; db.push(10 * Math.log10(s / h + 1e-12)); } window.__swing = { clarinet: +(Math.max(...db) - Math.min(...db)).toFixed(1) }; return window.__swing; })()

steps.msg: a held solo clarinet note is steady (summed velocity layers used to phase-beat 10 dB)

steps.eval: (async () => { const b = await __DQ.renderAudio('note:horns:A3:mf:12:60', 14); const d = b.getChannelData(0), sr = b.sampleRate, h = Math.floor(sr * 0.1); const db = []; for (let i = Math.floor(sr * 1.5); i + h < Math.floor(sr * 11); i += h) { let s = 0; for (let j = 0; j < h; j++) s += d[i + j] * d[i + j]; db.push(10 * Math.log10(s / h + 1e-12)); } window.__swing.horn = +(Math.max(...db) - Math.min(...db)).toFixed(1); return window.__swing; })()
